frame: SAMPLE DATA — this is what a recommendations pass looks like. Ranked by fit to logged hours, not review scores. Every pick is a game already owned with zero recorded minutes, every claim cites hours the owner can audit, and picks that get played move to the scoreboard with a verdict.

outcomes.recommended: #1 pick — Factorio 309h, owned since early access with 0 minutes

picks.why: City builder meets colony sim, and both buckets rank in this library's top four by hours-per-launched-game.
picks.evidence: Cities: Skylines 104h; RimWorld 206h; Timberborn owned, 0 minutes
picks.watch: Water physics update split the community on difficulty; start on default settings.

picks.why: The best-reviewed unplayed game in the library, and Ori's 55% Xbox completion says metroidvanias land when started.
picks.evidence: Ori and the Will of the Wisps 55% completion; Hollow Knight owned, 0 minutes
picks.watch: Famously oblique early hours — give it until the second boss before judging.

picks.why: Civ VI has 131h but Hearts of Iron got 3.7h — turn-based empire optimization in bounded sessions is the real pattern, and Slipways is a 4X in 90-minute runs.
picks.evidence: Civ VI 131h vs Hearts of Iron IV 3.7h; Slipways owned, 0 minutes
picks.watch: Abstract and puzzle-like; fans converge around ~30 great hours.

skips.evidence: 1.6h and 0.8% completion here, Vampire Survivors 2.5h — run-based games stick in this library only when they carry an economy layer (Against the Storm 42h, Balatro 33h).

on_hold.note: Owner's rule: buy early access to support it, play at 1.0.

attribution: Sample analysis over synthetic data. Hours are 'measured'; verdicts are opinion. See SKILL.md for the method.
